_comment: ml-commons FLOW AGENT registration -- also CONFIGURATION, not code. Register with: POST /_plugins/_ml/agents/_register (body = this file, minus _comment fields). It returns an agent_id. This is the SAME shape as today's 'Agentic Search DSL Agent' (type: flow), except the single tool is a ConnectorTool pointing at our connector instead of the in-JVM QueryPlanningTool. That one swap is what moves the NLQ->DSL translation out to the agent server.
name: Agentic Search Remote DSL Agent
description: FLOW agent that delegates NLQ->DSL generation to the agent server via ConnectorTool.
_comment_tools: Exactly ONE tool. Single-tool FLOW short-circuits in MLFlowAgentRunner (calls firstTool.run directly). connector_id comes from registering 01_connector.json.

tools.name: remote_dsl_generator
tools.description: Generates OpenSearch DSL from a natural-language question by calling the agent server.
